newsitem.title: UK: UK govt to warn on pensions loophole - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK govt to warn on pensions loophole - paper.

text.p: The British government is expected to warn on Thursday that it will move to block a potential insurance rebate loophole unless pension schemes give guarantees that they will not seek to exploit it, the Financial Times (FT)said on Thursday.
It follows talks between officials from the Department of Social Security and members of the Occupational Pensions Joint Working Group, an industry representative body, the FT said.

The loophole provides schemes with an opportunity to maximise the age-related national insurance rebates they receive. Some pension experts have suggested that, if the loophole is not closed, it could cost the government several hundred million stg, the FT said.
